description: Parse ISO 20022 SEPA files (pain.001 credit transfers .02 / .03 / .09, pain.008 direct debits .01 / .02 / .08, pain.002 payment status reports .03 / .10; one XML or a ZIP of up to 20) into one record per payment: batch, execution / collection date, counterparty name, IBAN with its check (mod 97, length, SEPA country), BIC, address, amount, EndToEndId, remittance text, RF reference check, sequence type, mandate. pain.002: status per payment with the reason code in plain words (AC04, AM04, MD01 ...). Group and batch control sums (NbOfTxs / CtrlSum) are checked and duplicate EndToEndIds flagged. Optional CSV as base64. Up to 1,000 rows per call. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/sepa-xml-to-excel.

csvSeparator.description: CSV separator; ';' writes a decimal comma

fileContent.description: Or the .xml / a .zip base64-encoded (max 12 MB per XML)

language.description: Language of status and reason texts

output.description: json = records only; csv also returns the table as base64 in outputFiles

xml.description: The SEPA file as XML text (empty = built-in sample: pain.001 with 5 payments in 2 batches)

name: sepa_xml_to_excel
title: SEPA XML to JSON & CSV API - read pain.001, pain.008 and pain.002, check IBANs and control sums
